answer_1.quote: Text summarization has enjoyed increasing popularity due to its wide applications, whereas the evaluation of text summarization remains challenging and controversial.

answer_2.quote: The most commonly used evaluation metric of summarization is lexical overlap, i.e., ROUGE, which regards the system and reference summaries as sequences of tokens and measures their n-gram overlap.
